notes: The largest SLO effect of the study is here (static_large 0.520 -> phase_hybrid 0.693), and it rests on a single run per configuration. Two interleaved repetitions of the same cell give (a) the run-to-run spread this machine produces on its own -- including how often a host stall lands in a run -- and (b) 300 paired requests instead of 150, which tightens the exact McNemar test. Everything else is identical to the main-matrix cell: same trace, same limit, same caps.

The burst window (48% of GPU seconds are prefill) at low load, where the ITL gate is the binding constraint. Tests whether the unloaded-cell result transfers to a different arrival pattern and a different length mix.
